test_title: PYST 211: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 1st Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: The average age of the employees of a company is 45 years. three employees of ages 38, 45 and 49 years resigned and three new employees of ages 42, 46 and 44 years joined. What is the average age of the employees now?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Number of employees in a company = X

Given the average age of the employees of a company is 45 years = 45X

Three employees of ages 38, 45 and 49 years resigned = 45X - (38 + 45 + 49)

The average age of employees in company after three employees resigned = 45X - 132

B
